column3: NKJV has “Brethren,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Beloved.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV ends this verse with “I write to you, little children,” which the critical text counts as the start of verse 14.
Close to the Greek; in the critical text this verse begins with the clause to the little children, which NKJV places at the end of verse 13.
NKJV has “you know all things,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “you all know.”
NKJV includes “he who acknowledges the Son has the Father also,” which the critical text also has but most Textus Receptus editions lack (the KJV printed it in italics).
NKJV has “you will abide in Him,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “abide in Him.”
